unknown_prefix: No command starts with '{name}' (type / to see all)

cmd_open: Open file with system default app (usage: /open <path>)
cmd_edit: Open file with VS Code (or default editor) (usage: /edit <path>)
at_skill_usage: Usage: @skill coding | writing | analysis | fiction | general
at_file_usage: Usage: @file <path> (relative to project dir or absolute, e.g. @file README.md)
at_file_is_dir: This is a folder; use @folder or specify a file.
skill_coding_desc: Focus on writing, fixing, debugging and explaining code
skill_writing_desc: Focus on writing, polishing, summarizing and reports
skill_analysis_desc: Focus on data analysis, statistics and reports
skill_fiction_desc: Focus on novels, stories, characters and plots
approval_non_tty: ⚠ This action needs human approval, but there is no interactive terminal. Denied.
approval_needed_header: ⚠ This action needs your approval before it runs:
approval_q_scoped: Allow? [y=once / a=allow the scope above for this session / n=deny (default)]
approval_q_once: Allow? [y=once / n=deny (default)] (this action must be approved every time)
approval_no_rule: This action cannot be always-allowed (it must be approved each time); treated as denied.
approval_auto_allowed: ⓘ Rule {rule} was already allowed for this session; auto-approved.
approval_remembered: Remembered: rule {rule} will not be asked again this session.
scope_shell_syntax: Every command in this session that relies on shell interpretation (pipes / redirects / operators / variable expansion)
scope_unparsable: Every command in this session that cannot be tokenized reliably (unbalanced quotes, etc.)
scope_path_qualified_binary: Every path-qualified executable in this session (bypassing the allowlist check)
scope_git_global_option: Every git command in this session carrying a global option before the subcommand
scope_not_allowlisted: Every command in this session that is not on the no-approval allowlist
scope_read_only_sandbox: Every write command in this session under the read-only sandbox
scope_path_escape: Every command in this session whose path arguments leave the workspace
scope_egress: Every request to {host} in this session (this host only)
scope_fallback: Every action in this session that matches rule {rule}
reason_shell_syntax: The command relies on shell interpretation (pipe / redirect / chaining / variable expansion) and needs manual confirmation
reason_unparsable: The command cannot be tokenized reliably (unclosed quote?) and needs manual confirmation
reason_path_qualified_binary: The base command carries a path ({base}), so the allowlist cannot vet it; manual confirmation needed
reason_git_global_option: Global options are not allowed before a git subcommand (-c can inject arbitrary commands); manual confirmation needed
reason_not_allowlisted: Command {base} is not on the no-approval allowlist and needs manual confirmation
reason_read_only_sandbox: The sandbox is read-only; a write command needs manual confirmation or a different sandbox policy
reason_path_escape: A path argument leaves the workspace ({offender}); manual confirmation needed
deny_tool_banned: Tool {tool} was cut off after repeated failures and will not be called again in this conversation
deny_plan_pending: A plan is still awaiting your approval, so tool execution is paused
deny_permission_level: Permission denied: tool {tool} requires a higher permission level
detail_more_hint: ↳ Run with --verbose (or DEBUG log level) for the full text
compact_done: ⓘ Context compacted: {before} → {after} tokens (earlier turns folded into a summary)
compact_failed: ⚠ Context compaction errored, skipped this turn: {err}
undo_done: Rolled back to latest snapshot {id} ({iso}, {n} file(s))
undo_none: No snapshot to roll back (a snapshot is auto-created before each write)
stall_abort: WARNING: Agent failed/blocked for {n} consecutive rounds and was auto-aborted. Please rephrase your request or check the model.
runner_banner: Agent started | model: {mode} | permission: {perm} | working dir: {root} | native tools: {tools}
runner_warn_write: ⚠ Current permission is write: terminal_exec can run arbitrary shell commands. Start with readonly in production.
runner_hint: Type a message to start chatting; type exit / quit to leave.
model_not_configured: No model configured: pass --base-url/--api-key/--model, or write them into ~/.ai_code.json; --mock also gives you an offline demo
model_api_failed_formats: Model API call failed (all request formats tried): {err}
model_hint_bad_model_name: Hint: this endpoint has no such model name. Switch with /model glm-4.6 (real Zhipu model codes, e.g. glm-4.6 / glm-4.5-air), or change the endpoint with /config
model_err_401: API key is invalid or expired. Reconfigure the full key with /config (note: new Zhipu keys start with 'id.' — no spaces or line breaks), or regenerate it in the provider console
model_err_403: Key is not allowed to access this model: check account permissions/quota, or pick another model name
model_err_404: Endpoint or model does not exist: check base_url and the model name (e.g. glm-4-flash / deepseek-chat)
model_err_429: Too many requests or quota exhausted: retry later, or check your balance in the console
sanity_zai_alias: The model name looks like a ZAI gateway alias (deepseek-v4-*), which BigModel does not accept directly — switch with /model glm-4.6
rollback_bad_id: Malformed snapshot id (expected timestamp_tag; list them with /snapshots)
rollback_confirm: Roll back to {id}? This overwrites the current file state [y/N]:
open_notepad_fallback: No default program for this file type; opened with Notepad: {path}
